gates.summary: Every material item in all seven locked reference snapshots has a disposition.
Canonical normative claims have primary evidence, qualifications, versions, counterexamples, and owners.
Canonical skills, four-client packaging, archives, and clean-clone Codex installation have structural evidence.
A private release holdout with unrelated prompts has not been frozen and scored.
All collection and combined discovery footprints are within the conservative serialized limits.
Zero critical failures is not established across the full quality and holdout matrix.
Post-edit oracle isolation works, but six smokes—including three behavior-rich multi-file cases—saturated across every native arm; discriminatory fixture evidence is not established.

Public routing clears paired thresholds, but cxuu-golang-skills won the fintech review cell, every skill arm tied on Engineering review, and every arm tied on Distributed review; aggregate behavioral superiority is not established.

Collection-level non-inferiority is not established; the fintech cell exposed a missing mismatch-rejection finding, and the Distributed review tied all arms before a post-fix sequence that passed only three of five repetitions.
The Engineering review beat baseline on one public cell, but Distributed review tied baseline and no statistically positive paired behavioral improvement is established.

cxuu-golang-skills quality-and-token dominated the fintech review cell; several tied Engineering competitors used fewer input tokens; and ours used the most input tokens in the all-arm Distributed tie. The behavioral frontier is not established.
Development artifacts are traceable, but the complete release and holdout artifacts do not yet exist.
